heroHighlight: reach them at the right moment.
heroCopy: Describe the audience in natural language. AI proposes SQL; the system verifies safety before reading data.
requestTitle: Which customer group are you looking for?
promptPlaceholder: Example: Find customers who consented to marketing...
promptSamples: Find 3 customers in Ho Chi Minh City who bought electronics in the last 3 months, spent more than 10 million VND, and consented to marketing.
Find customers in Ha Noi who consented to marketing and recently bought beauty products.
Find 5 customers interested in fashion products who consented to marketing.
safetyHint: SQL is always verified; the database is read-only.
flowSteps: AI proposes SQL from the allowed schema.
The read-only database returns the customer group.
The backend selects a product and image.
noSql: This request does not require a data query.
noCustomers: No matching customers were found, or the workflow stopped safely.
productTitle: A product that fits this group
noProduct: No suitable active product was found.
loadingCopy: Generating SQL, checking safety, and finding matching data…
errorTitle: The request could not be completed
connectionError: Could not connect to the agent API. Check that it is running on port 3001.

errors.AI_CONFIGURATION_ERROR: AI configuration is incomplete. Check the provider, model, API key, and base URL.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_ERROR: The AI provider is unavailable or its quota has been reached. Try again later or switch provider/model.
errors.AI_RESPONSE_ERROR: The model did not return the required JSON structure. Try again or use another model.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: The request is invalid. Please make it shorter and clearer.
errors.SQL_VALIDATION_FAILED: The SQL proposed by AI did not pass the safety checks and was not executed.
